name: Reverse Engineering procs from periodic healing ticks (#1965)
contract: Original Reverse Engineering 520875 procs Replenishment and the 15 percent haste aura 520936 from the
caster's periodic healing. The effective proc row uses the authored 15 percent chance and no cooldown.
Collect at least 100 native periodic heals through ten funded ordinary Accelerated Recovery casts,
injuring the caster before each tick so healing has a real target. Sample native haste amounts and cast
speed throughout; require an actual triggered haste cast and its authored cast-speed effect at a
checkpoint. Preserve proc chance, normal costs, cooldowns and native tick scheduling. A single finite
heal-over-time is insufficient to make a 15 percent chance regression reliable.
